Name: JBT Seasonal Makeover
Author: JBTmod
Description:
[b]JBT Seasonal Makeover[/b]

A Content Patcher pack combining seasonal NPC sprites, large dialogue-side portraits, and a coordinated dialogue layout for vanilla Stardew Valley and supported Stardew Valley Expanded characters.

[b]Features[/b]
• Seasonal outfits for the characters covered by this pack.
• General-purpose portraits for selected special-scene characters rather than four separate outfits.
• Large portraits on the left, anchored to the bottom, with dialogue on the lower right.
• Adult standing portraits generally use a below-knee composition; children and seated characters retain appropriate individual framing.
• Male and female Wizard artwork, selected through WizardVersion: Auto, Male, or Female.
• Includes the revised Demetrius seasonal sprite exports and existing corrected portrait assets.
• Contains 273 portrait atlas PNGs and 256 sprite PNGs. These are asset-file counts, not character or unique-expression counts.

[b]Requirements[/b]
Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Dialogue Display Framework Continued separately. The reference setup uses Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2, Content Patcher 2.9.1, and DDFC 0.7.5. Compatibility with other versions has not been established.
Stardew Valley Expanded is optional for vanilla play and required to encounter its NPCs. This pack does not add NPCs, maps, quests, or events.

[b]Installation[/b]
1. Back up your existing visual mods and close the game.
2. Install the requirements from their original pages.
3. Extract the archive and place [CP] JBT Seasonal Makeover directly in your game's Mods folder.
4. Remove older JBT combined/split portrait and sprite packages from Mods before installing. Do not install multiple packages with the same UniqueID.
5. Disable other portrait/sprite replacement packs targeting the same NPCs, and other dialogue layout packs affecting the same DDFC entries.
6. Launch using SMAPI.

[b]Compatibility and limitations[/b]
The layout was tuned for a 1920×1008 game client area. Different resolutions and UI scale settings may need adjustment. Do not assume every seasonal alias, event pose, expression index, or third-party character variant has been tested.
Other portrait or sprite replacements may conflict even when the game launches without errors. The included late replacement patches intentionally override the affected character artwork.
This is a Beta release. Asset dimensions, transparency channels, archive structure, and referenced paths have been checked; comprehensive in-game seasonal and event testing is still required.

[b]Configuration[/b]
After first launch, edit config.json in the mod folder to set WizardVersion to Auto, Male, or Female. Auto uses the supported female Wizard mod detection. Selecting Female changes artwork only; it does not add the female Wizard's gameplay content.

[b]Uninstallation[/b]
Close the game and remove this pack's folder from Mods. Restore previous visual mods if desired. Do not delete shared frameworks if other mods still need them.

[b]AI disclosure[/b]
Portrait and sprite artwork was generated with AI tools, selected and revised through human feedback, and mechanically prepared for the game's asset layout. The pack must be tagged AI-Generated Content. AI was also used to assist with packaging and documentation.

[b]Credits and permissions[/b]
JBT: art direction, selection, integration, and layout.
ConcernedApe: Stardew Valley and its characters.
Pathoschild: SMAPI / Content Patcher ecosystem.
Mangupix: Dialogue Display Framework Continued.


[b]Bug reports[/b]
Please include your SMAPI log, game and framework versions, NPC name, season, scene/event, resolution, UI scale, and a screenshot. Report whether another portrait, sprite, or dialogue-layout pack is installed. 


本包是四季人物小人、对话侧边立绘和对话框布局的整合美化，不是整套游戏 Mod 合集。前置框架、其他作者的完整模组和存档均不随包分发。

成人站立人物大多使用膝下构图，儿童不按成人比例裁切；轮椅与特殊角色保留适合自身的构图。部分特殊场景人物使用通用肖像，不宣称所有人物都有四套服装或每个表情均为独立绘制。

安装：退出游戏，备份旧美化，将 ZIP 内的 [color=rgba(26, 28, 31, 0.494)][u][[/u][/color][color=#2c67c5][u]CP[/u][/color][color=rgba(26, 28, 31, 0.494)][u]][/u][/color] JBT Seasonal Makeover 文件夹放入 Mods。移出旧 JBT 合并包和两个拆分包；其他针对相同人物的肖像、小人及 DDFC 界面替换建议关闭。通过 SMAPI 启动。

参考环境为星露谷物语 1.6.15、SMAPI 4.5.2、Content Patcher 2.9.1、DDFC 0.7.5；界面按1920×1008游戏客户区校准。其他环境需要自行实测。含AI生成素材，目前为测试版，欢迎提交附带日志和截图的问题报告。
